title: Travel & directions — B1
description: Frases y vocabulario para viajar y moverse por una ciudad.

vocab.example: May I see your boarding pass?
I'd like an aisle seat, please.
I have a 2-hour layover in Madrid.
You need to go through customs first.
The tower is a famous landmark.
There's a detour due to construction.

speaking.target: Ask for directions to the nearest subway station.

writing.prompt: Write a short email to a hotel asking about check-in and airport shuttle.
